description: Add one or more products to the user's Picnic shopping cart. Get the product ids from search_products first; put all products the user asked for in one call (at most 20). Returns each added product with the quantity now in the cart, the products that failed, and the cart total. A product that can't be delivered in the selected delivery window has `unavailable` and `replacements`: tell the user and offer them. To change how many of a product are in the cart ("make it 4"), use set_cart_quantity instead. This does not place an order.

productId.description: The product id from search_products or get_cart, e.g. s1004201.

name: add_to_cart
title: Add to cart
